question: Which city has the most people?
SQL: SELECT name FROM city ORDER BY population DESC LIMIT 1

question: Name and territory of customers who ordered a helmet.
SQL: SELECT DISTINCT c.name, c.territory FROM customer AS c JOIN sales_order AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_line AS l ON l.order_id = o.order_id JOIN product AS p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Helmet'
